style.vernacular: Dense high-altitude metropolis: concrete-frame mid-rise apartment and office blocks with flat roofs, rooftop water tanks and washing lines; colourful painted render in terracotta, ochre, pink and blue on older low-rise streets; Spanish colonial churches and palaces in dark red tezontle volcanic stone trimmed with grey-white chiluca/cantera stone; mid-20th-century modernist and brutalist public buildings in exposed concrete, and glass towers along Reforma and Santa Fe. Flat roofs dominate, with clay tile on colonial buildings.
style.ornament: Colonial baroque portals in carved grey stone against red tezontle walls, Talavera tile domes in yellow and blue, Barragan-style saturated pink, red and yellow walls, 1950s UNAM-era modernist murals and mosaics, brutalist concrete cladding, large painted street murals, Aztec stepped-pyramid ruins.
